name: vt-grid-lost

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan

description: Both ways a grid becomes untrustworthy lead the core to the stale flow with cause grid_lost, no gap_seq (5.52; C2 decision 10). A frame that jumped without a gap frame is refused with error seq_jump and the grid is left unchanged (D18); a restore carrying a snapshot from another engine version is refused with error snapshot_incompatible (D21). The VT's refusals are shown here; the core's resume path — on either refusal, or for a shell session no grid holds, the core closes that grid when one exists and opens an empty one, feeds it from the first frame the old grid did not apply (the refused frame itself after seq_jump; the empty grid takes the first frame it is fed as its start, so a feed that starts past seq 1 is applied, not refused), and raises the stale flow with cause grid_lost; the new grid starts blank and its dump shows what it has applied since, so attaches proceed — is the core's own state, graded by the U2 core (owed), and its gap framing is on the C3 socket. This fixture invents no cross-socket machinery.
